name: Container plane: registry catalog -> docker daemon -> portainer/consul/nomad
goal: Sweep the container management plane: image catalog disclosure, Docker API takeover, and orchestrator/SDN consoles.
impact: Image/source theft, container takeover via Docker API, orchestration control.

steps.purpose: Registry catalog + tag enumeration = image names as org-source intel.
steps.on_success: Image inventory; pull manifests for env-in-image secrets (documented follow-up).

steps.purpose: Exposed :2375 Docker API = host-level container control.
steps.on_success: Container exec narrative (documented next step); highest infra impact.

steps.purpose: Portainer exposure signals and often management capabilities.
Consul service catalog: internal service map for lateral moves.
Nomad job listing: workload names, drivers, groups — env and task intel.
steps.on_success: Job specs often reveal env vars and image refs.
steps.on_fail: Next service; Vault health (infra/Vault sys/health unauth disclosure) completes the sweep.

entry_points: CI environments that self-host these services

recon.name: Banner triangulation
recon.how: Each service has a distinctive version/status JSON — probe all canonical ports in one sweep.

recon.name: Adjacent-host propagation
recon.how: Findings on one infra host imply sibling services on neighbors — sweep the subnet via latency techniques.

recon.name: CI-adjacency inference
recon.how: CI servers and build agents almost always run registries/daemons on the same host or subnet — start the sweep from every Jenkins/GitLab hit.
recon.signal: Infra API answers on a CI-adjacent host.

variants: registry manifest pull for image secrets
vault token reading via health exposure paths
pivot_hints: docker API -> mount host filesystem narrative

sources: Docker Engine API docs (security note on 2375)
